findings.evidence: `cartanMatrix_apply` (CartanMatrix.lean:148) gives the FG module as `⟨(P j).obj, (ModuleCat.isFG_iff _).mpr _⟩`. `jordanHolderMultiplicity_vertexProjectiveModuleFG_eq_card_path` (Multiplicity.lean:141) is stated for `vertexProjectiveModuleFG k Q j`. The two are reconciled only by `rfl` at line 248 and implicitly by `exact_mod_cast` at line 262.
findings.fix: State the identification once as a named lemma, e.g. `jordanHolderMultiplicity_vertexProjectiveFiniteProjective_eq_card_path`, with the FG-module form that `cartanMatrix_apply` and `cartanMap_of_eq_sum` produce. Rewrite with it in both theorems, or derive the cartanMap result from `cartanMatrix_vertexProjectiveFiniteProjective_apply`.
findings.issue: `cartanMatrix_vertexProjectiveFiniteProjective_apply` closes its goal with `exact_mod_cast`. This silently relies on `⟨(vertexProjectiveFiniteProjective k Q j).obj, _⟩ : FGModuleCat` being definitionally `vertexProjectiveModuleFG k Q j` (structure eta plus proof irrelevance), and there is no comment. `cartanMap_vertexProjectiveFiniteProjective` (line 248) relies on the same identification with `rw [← …]; rfl`.

findings.evidence: `Projective/Acyclic.lean:56-58`: `Finite.of_injective (fun p : Quiver.Path i a ↦ (⟨i, a, p⟩ : Σ x y : Q, Quiver.Path x y)) fun p q hpq ↦ by simpa using hpq`. CartanMap.lean:281-283 repeats this argument.
findings.fix: Add a lemma such as `finite_path_of_module_finite_pathAlgebra` (or a generic sigma-projection version) next to `finite_hom_of_module_finite_pathAlgebra` in `Quiver/Acyclic/PathAlgebra.lean`, and use it at both sites.
findings.issue: The proof gets `Finite (Quiver.Path a b)` from `Finite (Σ a b, Quiver.Path a b)` with an inline `Finite.of_injective` / `simpa using hpq` argument. This is a verbatim copy of existing code instead of a reusable lemma.

summary: Two proofs in CartanMap.lean depend on an undocumented structure-eta definitional equality between the vertex projective and `vertexProjectiveModuleFG`. A path-finiteness argument is copied from an existing file instead of being factored into a lemma.
